Did not help: schedule changes (warmup 0.05: 1.1251, warmup 0.02: 1.1245, cosine: 1.1346, cosine with restarts: 1.1357 and 1.1558). Weaker weight decay (0.001: 1.1172, 0.01: 1.1188) was worse.
